versions.content: If disabling the watchdog is not allowed (e.g. in safety relevant systems, seeECUC_Wdg_00115) the Wdg_SetMode function shall check whether the settings for the requested mode would disable the watchdog. In this case, the func- tion shall not execute the mode switch but raise the extended production error WDG_ E_DISABLE_REJECTED and return with the value E_NOT_OK.
